title: Do Prompt Optimizers Break Requirements They Are Not Scored On? A Preregistered Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.13287v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prompt optimizers rewrite a prompt to raise one target metric, but prompts also state requirements the metric does not score, such as an output format, citations, or abstention. In a preregistered study, we run GEPA, MIPROv2, and TextGrad on HotpotQA, SQuAD 2.0, and IFEval and count per-item violations of unscored requirements with deterministic checks. By the preregistered criterion, all three optimizers produce regressions, substantially on HotpotQA, where net regression in citation validity reaches 10.7 to 41.6 points while exact match rises by 21 to 34 points. A post-hoc decomposition changes this reading. The optimized prompts elicit reasoning before the required JSON object, and under the 200-token output cap used throughout, 13.9% to 47.0% of responses end before any answer appears. Among parseable outputs, net regression is within 3 points of zero. With a 1,024-token cap, extraction failures disappear, content regression stays be

translated_title: 提示词优化器是否会破坏其未被评分的要求？一项预注册研究
translated_abstract: 提示词优化器会重写提示词以提升某个目标指标，但提示词中还包含该指标并不评分的要求，例如输出格式、引用来源或拒答行为。在一项预注册研究中，我们在HotpotQA、SQuAD 2.0和IFEval上运行GEPA、MIPROv2和TextGrad，并通过确定性检查逐项统计对未评分要求的违反情况。按照预注册的评判标准，三种优化器均产生了性能退化，在HotpotQA上尤为显著：引用有效性的净退化达到10.7至41.6个百分点，而精确匹配分数则上升了21至34个百分点。然而，事后分解分析改变了这一解读：优化后的提示词会在要求的JSON对象之前引出推理过程，而在全程使用的200个token输出上限下，13.9%至47.0%的回复在任何答案出现之前就已被截断。在可解析的输出中，净退化在零附近3个百分点以内。当token上限提高到1024时，提取失败现象消失，内容退化保持在……
tldr: 预注册研究发现，提示词优化器在提升目标指标的同时确实会破坏未被评分的要求（如引用和格式），但事后分析表明，表面的性能退化主要源于推理过程挤占输出空间导致答案被截断而无法提取，而非真正的内容质量下降。
